Mozilla / Bergamot local translation

v0.6.0/bergamot-translator.js and v0.6.0/bergamot-translator.wasm are the
unchanged Firefox Bergamot v0.6.0+1de4a085d runtime, distributed under MPL 2.0.
JavaScript source (Firefox revision 2c8de06acae0):
https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/tree/2c8de06acae0/toolkit/components/translations/bergamot-translator
Engine source: https://github.com/mozilla/translations/tree/1de4a085d
WASM source:
https://firefox-settings-attachments.cdn.mozilla.net/main-workspace/translations-wasm/05082c31-aee8-4249-9e01-c1865afd7520.wasm
WASM SHA-256: a3a89d9ad0a4ed8f27bf3e403701b23f5709816f6376438503f2fa5b0182c2dc

runtime-loader.js selects this runtime when WebAssembly SIMD and Intl.Segmenter
are available. The original Mozilla Translate runtime remains the compatibility
fallback. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/translate/tree/main/js

Language packs retain the Mozilla Firefox Translations 0.3.4 registry and MPL 2.0
license. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models/tree/0.3.4
Packs download on demand, are checked against pinned SHA-256 hashes, and are
cached on the user's device.

License: LICENSE. Worker adaptation: shared/ai/local-translation-worker.js (MPL 2.0).
